description: issue #691: `play` (Sound profile, arity 1) resolves an even-length melody list of pitch/duration pairs and emits EXACTLY ONE `sound` event carrying the ordered melody as {pitch, duration} steps. Pitches are `note` pitch words or the literal `"rest"`; durations are carried verbatim in beats, never converted at emit (spec/interaction-events.md:346-347,372-386). The runtime models sound headlessly (scheduling + event emission, never an audio device), so the event is emitted unconditionally even in a muted environment. The `sound` event follows the instruction event ("Sound commands emit `sound` events after sound state has been scheduled").
